comment: Mechanically checkable subset of .dev/guardrails/. The markdown guardrails remain canonical; every rule references its source. JSON, not YAML, because rule patterns are regexes and must survive parsing byte for byte.

rules.message: subprocess with shell=True risks command injection. Pass args as a list.
os.system is disallowed. Use subprocess with a list of args.
Possible hardcoded credential. Use environment variables or a secret store.
Piping downloads to a shell is disallowed. Download, verify, then execute.
eval on dynamic input is dangerous. Prefer explicit parsing.
